description: Language-neutral cross-client conformance corpus. Both the JS runner (run.mjs) and the Python runner (packages/sdk-python/tests/test_conformance.py) execute these cases against a locally-built worker and assert the same expectations, so the two clients cannot drift on the covered behaviour. `model` is the constant name each client resolves from its own registry (qvac.models / @qvac/sdk). Completion/translation pin sampling with greedy decoding + a fixed seed, but that only pins the sampler -- the backend's numerics still shift with the CPU the runner hands out, so a case must not hinge on the model taking one specific long path. Cases whose assertion depends on the model emitting a particular structure (tool calls above all) therefore also pin `reasoning_budget: 0`, which keeps the 0.6B model out of a `<think>` ramble that can burn the whole `predict` budget before it ever emits the call. Most cases run on both clients; a case whose capability only one client exposes today is driven by that client and logged as a skip by the other -- e.g. `completionOrchestrate` is the WORKER-driven tool loop, which only the Python client wraps (`completion_orchestrate`); the JS client drives tool loops client-side, so its runner skips that case rather than reimplementing the loop.
